_note: Two-hop compositionality chains for the connection-gap experiment (prereg TBD). Crafted per Press et al. 'compositionality gap' + Yang et al. latent-multihop: bridge TYPE tunes difficulty (year/abstract bridges fail latent composition ~95%; country/nationality easier). hop1 finds the bridge; hop2 is a property of the bridge; composed requires chaining through the bridge without naming it. Round-1 keeps chains where the 4B answers hop1 AND hop2 but FAILS composed. Bridges chosen single-token-ish for later J-lens tracking.
